corrections.reason: The skill asks kids to choose safe ways to act with allergies, but no listed prerequisite covers allergies. g2-hlth-food-allergies teaches the common food allergies and their reactions, which a kid needs before they can pick allergy safety rules. It does not depend on anything listed here, so adding it is not redundant.

The skill covers screen use as well as substances, but the only listed prerequisite is g3-hlth-substances, which does not cover screen time. g1-hlth-healthy-habits teaches how screen time and other habits harm or help. g2-hlth-medicines is left out on purpose: g3-hlth-substances already depends on it, so listing it directly would be redundant under the direct-prerequisite rule.

output.notes: Reviewed all 14 Grade 3 skills against the prerequisite rules. Two need corrections: g3-hlth-safety-guidelines is missing the allergy prerequisite, and g3-hlth-healthy-choices is missing the screen-time habits prerequisite. The other skills have real, direct, non-redundant prerequisites that point only to earlier grades. Titles and descriptions are clear and suitable to read aloud, so no wording changes are needed.
